story.intro_aelia.1: Ash? … Ash, it's me. Can you hear me, through the embers?
story.intro_aelia.2: He locked me at the top of the tower. I'm becoming his Lantern. Come and get me.
story.intro_vesper.1: You again. The Master says you never truly die.
story.intro_vesper.2: I say you die a lot. I'm Vesper. I guard the cage. And I keep count.
story.intro_thot.1: Ah… a visitor. Forgive my cracks: I am Thoth, or what is left of him.
story.intro_thot.2: Your XP helps me remember. And I help you remember what you can do.
story.intro_brokk.1: Put your parts here, kid. I'm Brokk. I used to forge for the gods.
story.intro_brokk.2: Now I forge for a caged bird. Fine by me. Metal judges no one.
story.boss_ammit.1: Ammit weighs hearts. Yours is heavy with anger, Ash. Breathe… and watch where she bites.
story.boss_fenrir.1: The wolf is chained too, you know. Like you. Like me. He strikes because he can't run.
story.boss_talos.1: Talos? I've seen his plans. When his beam sweeps, it starts from one edge: run to the other.
story.boss_oiseleur.1: You saw him… He doesn't hate you, Ash. That's the worst part.
story.boss_oiseleur.2: The Master wept, afterwards. Don't tell anyone.
story.reach_frost.1: You got past the Lowtown! I felt it: the Lantern flickered, just for a moment.
story.reach_olympus.1: Corporate Olympus… My old colleagues sell light by the meter there. Don't spare them.
story.reach_aviary.1: The Aviary. My home. Don't touch the cages… Actually, do. All of them. Open them all.
story.deaths_5.1: Five rebirths. Each time, the cage drinks a little of your flame. I can hear it creak.
story.deaths_15.1: Fifteen. The Master smiles every time you come back. I'm starting to count for you.
story.deaths_30.1: Thirty times you fell, thirty times you came back. I don't know where you find it, Ash. But I love you for it.
story.victory_1.1: You beat him! I heard him fall… But the Lantern won't open. Something seals it.
story.victory_1.2: An oath. The Oath of the gods. I can feel it in my cracked circuits: it holds the door shut.
story.victory_2.1: Fine. I'll tell you, since you always come back: every time you're reborn, the cage captures your flame.
story.victory_2.2: You light the city, Ash. All of Nox's light is paid for by your deaths.
story.victory_3.1: I've deciphered the prophecy: “When the ash finds the flame again, the Dawn will be reborn.”
story.victory_3.2: The flame is me, I think. I can feel it burning deep in the Lantern. So the ash…
story.victory_4.1: The gods speak in my light at night. They swore to survive. They traded the sun for their lives.
story.victory_4.2: They're not evil, Ash. They were afraid. Like everyone.
story.victory_5.1: Sit down. I melted your parts with an ember from your cage. There: the Blade of Dawn. It was waiting for you.
story.victory_5.2: Ash… you are not cursed. You were born from the ashes of the Dawn, the Phoenix-Sun. You are what remains of the day.
story.victory_6.1: A crack! A god broke the Oath. The Lantern is splitting, I can almost see the sky.
story.victory_6.2: The Master felt the crack. He said nothing. He stared at it for a long time.
story.victory_7.1: The Master was the Phoenix's guardian. Ten thousand years watching it die every night. He just wanted it to stop.
story.victory_7.2: He wanted to abolish death… and he put out the morning. We can understand him. We can't let him do it.
story.victory_8.1: I remember everything now. The neon signs we lit together, the rooftops, your laugh.
story.victory_8.2: Ash… when it's over, what will we do? I want to see a real morning. With you.
story.victory_9.1: The Fowler is doubting. I can hear it in the tower's cables. Next time, he may not fight the same way.
story.victory_9.2: He asked me if you were afraid. I told him you never had the time.
story.victory_10.1: You came. You always came. The ash has found the flame again.
story.victory_10.2: Then open it. The cage. I no longer have the strength to keep it shut… and I don't think I want to.
story.victory_10.3: Look, Ash. The sky is changing color. The sun is rising over Nox.
story.after_end.1: The Master is gone. The cage stays open… but some stay out of habit. One more escape? Just for fun?
ending.title: The Dawn Rises
ending.1: The ash has found the flame again.
ending.2: At the top of the tower, the Lantern opened, and Aelia saw her first morning.
ending.3: The Fowler opened the last cage himself. Then he sat down and watched the Phoenix be reborn.
ending.4: Tonight, the sun will die. Tomorrow, it will be reborn. Like Ash.
ending.continue: Tap to return to the Cage

event.ember.desc: One of Aelia's embers still burns here. It can wake a god… if you feed it a little of your life.

codex.title: Thoth's Archives
codex.intro: Everything Thoth managed to record. An entry opens on the first encounter.
codex.unknownDesc: Thoth has recorded nothing here yet. Meet it to learn more.
codex.enemy.prowler: Kids from the Lowtown, paid in light by the Consortium. They strike fast and in packs, but give up after one good hit.
codex.enemy.gunner: A turret on legs that fires a neon shard. Its barrel lights up before it fires: that's your cue to move.
codex.enemy.brute: A dock worker swollen with implants. Slow, but every blow is worth three of yours. Let it swing at nothing.
codex.enemy.stalker: The Consortium's personal hunter. It charges in straight lines, several times in a row. An obstacle between you breaks its momentum.
codex.enemy.wolfbot: Network relay wolves guarding the Frost Server. Fragile alone; in packs, they surround you.
codex.enemy.frostcaster: A cooling AI turned hostile. It throws three frost shards in a fan: slip between them.
codex.enemy.runewarden: An old warden carving runes into the floor. The circles burst after a moment: get out in time.
codex.enemy.einherjar: One of Odin's warriors, brought back by the cold. Its shield blocks everything from the front: hit it from behind.
codex.enemy.hoplite: Private security of Corporate Olympus. Disciplined and armored, they take more than they seem.
codex.enemy.harpy: Delivery drones reprogrammed to dive at intruders. The dive is fast but always announced.
codex.enemy.oracle: A priestess wired to the prediction servers. Her beam tracks you, then locks: step aside at the last moment.
codex.enemy.minotaur: Guardian of the office maze, model Ω. It charges without stopping; walls and pillars are your friends.
codex.enemy.sparrow: Small steel birds born in the Aviary's forges. Harmless alone, exhausting by the dozen.
codex.enemy.crow: The Fowler's eyes. They spit five sharp feathers in a fan. Close in fast.
codex.enemy.jailer: It lays snare-nets on the floor, like its master. Never stand still near it.
codex.enemy.herald: It recites the Oath the gods swore. Its beam is slow but devastating, and its shield guards its front.
codex.boss.ammit: The Devourer of hearts, watchdog of the Lowtown. She weighs the souls of runaways… and swallows them.
codex.boss.fenrir: The great wolf, chained in the cold of the servers. Every broken chain makes him wilder.
codex.boss.talos: The bronze giant guarding Corporate Olympus. He never sleeps and strikes the ground until the towers shake.
codex.boss.oiseleur: The god of nets, cages and oaths. He caught the Dawn so that nothing would ever die again. He believes he is protecting you.
codex.god.ra: Egypt's sun, reduced to an ember under the Oath. His boons burn enemies long after the hit.
codex.god.anubis: Judge of the dead. He weighs weakened enemies and finishes those no longer fit to fight.
codex.god.bastet: Guardian of homes, quick as a cat. She grants speed and critical hits.
codex.god.zeus: Master of lightning. His bolts leap from one enemy to the next, warning no one.
codex.god.athena: The strategist. Her aegis blocks blows and sends projectiles back where they came from.
codex.god.artemis: Huntress of the moon. Her arrows find their mark, even very far away.
codex.god.skadi: Goddess of winter. Her cold slows, then freezes solid.
codex.god.thor: Thunder of the North. His hammer stuns and pushes back everything around him.
codex.god.hel: Queen of the dead, half alive. She curses enemies and grants a last breath to those she loves.

recap.where.cleared: The Fowler has fallen. The Lantern still shines atop the tower.
spark.title: Phoenix Spark
spark.subtitle: One of your boons gains a rarity tier
codex.memory.none: No memories yet. Dialogues from the Cage appear here once heard.
story.marks_thot.1: Careful. The Fowler marks some of his servants: armored corners, chevrons, crowns of spikes. I have recorded them. And when a spiked one falls… step away.
story.trials_vesper.1: Seen my trials? The Master says a prisoner in a hurry is a prisoner who makes mistakes. Prove him wrong, if you can.
story.archives_thot.1: I have reopened my archives. Every creature you strike down, I record. Read them: knowledge cuts deeper than a blade.
story.ember_aelia.1: I've scattered embers along your path, Ash. If you find one, feed it.
story.ember_aelia.2: But not too much. I need you to come back whole.
story.anvil_brokk.1: If you come across one of my old anvils, help yourself. Nobody has used them since the light went out.
story.spark_aelia.1: Those sparks you gather… that's the Phoenix. What's left of him.
story.spark_aelia.2: Or what's left of you. I have not yet decided which hypothesis to archive.
codex.weapon.katana: A slim blade, fast and reliable. Ash found it in the Lowtown, stuck in a broken neon sign. Perfect for learning the rhythm of combat.
codex.weapon.twinBlades: Two short blades, for those who like to strike fast and often. They sing when they clash.
codex.weapon.staff: A staff carved from a rune stone. It strikes from afar and blows up the ground where you aim.
codex.weapon.crossbow: A hunter's crossbow, reloaded by a small motor. Its charged bolts pierce through enemy lines.
codex.weapon.disc: A shard of the sun's chariot, cut into a disc by Brokk. Thrown, it always comes back to your hand.
codex.weapon.chain: The chain that bound Fenrir, stolen from the Frost Server. It pulls small enemies in… or pulls you toward big ones.
codex.weapon.dawnblade: Forged by Brokk from a Phoenix feather. Heavy and slow, but its guard returns every blow with the strength of dawn.
codex.npc.aelia: Your wife. A neon-lighter from the Lowtown, she unknowingly carries the last flame of the Dawn. The Fowler locked her atop his tower, where she became the Lantern.
codex.npc.thot: The archivist god, reduced to a cracked AI haunting the Cage's terminals. He records everything, doubts everything, and helps you in his own way.
codex.npc.vesper: The Fowler's mechanical raven. He watches the Cage, mocks you… and sometimes seems to help you more than he should.
codex.npc.brokk: The smith, driven from his workshop when the light went out. He forges and upgrades your weapons for parts gathered along the way.
codex.npc.oiseleur: The god of nets, cages and oaths, older than the three pantheons. He caught the Dawn so that nothing would ever die again.

event.well.title: Ratatosk's Well
event.well.desc: Ratatosk swears this old well grants wishes… for a few shards. Perhaps a god will hear you.
event.shrine.title: Thoth's Shrine
event.shrine.desc: An old Thoth terminal. It can archive your fight, but it feeds on a little of your life.
skill.thoth_rebirth.desc: {value} time(s) per run, a lethal blow brings you back with 40% of your HP.
rack.title: Weapon Rack
rack.intro: Choose the weapon you take along. Locked weapons are unlocked at Brokk's.
merchant.title: Ratatosk's Trading Post
merchant.name: Ratatosk
merchant.greet.1: Shards? I've got just what you need, friend!
merchant.greet.2: I run between the worlds. News travels fast… so do prices.
merchant.greet.3: The Master of the tower hates me trading with you. All the more reason!
merchant.greet.4: Come closer, come closer! Everything's guaranteed… until the next room.
merchant.greet.5: Still alive? Good news for business.
bark.brokk.1: Don't touch the anvil. It bites.
bark.brokk.2: My hammer's name is Gerald. Don't ask.
bark.brokk.3: I've been forging for three thousand years. You've been dying for three days. Respect your elders.
bark.brokk.4: Parts, parts… You think metal grows on trees?
bark.brokk.5: Come back with a broken weapon, I'll fix it. Come back broken, go see Aelia.
bark.brokk.6: I forged for Thor once. He never says thank you either.
bark.thot.1: Rebirth #{deaths} archived. I'm running out of space.
bark.thot.2: Statistically, you should be discouraged. Statistically.
bark.thot.3: I don't judge. I archive. It's worse.
bark.thot.4: Update in progress… Oh no. That's just you breathing loudly.
bark.thot.5: Free advice: avoid dying. Paid advice is more detailed.
bark.thot.6: Error 404: motivation not found. Ah, there it is. Under your cloak.
bark.vesper.1: Caw. That's what a normal raven would say. I'd rather judge you.
bark.vesper.2: The Master says you're stubborn. I say you're slow.
bark.vesper.3: The door again? It leads to the same place as last time, you know.
bark.vesper.4: I'm not helping you. I'm optimizing your suffering. Big difference.
bark.vesper.5: If you win, I saw nothing. If you lose, I filmed everything.
bark.aelia.1: Have you eaten? Oh, right… you're made of ashes.
bark.aelia.2: If you meet the Fowler, tell him his decor is awful.
bark.aelia.3: I'm waiting for you. But hurry: I have a whole city to light.
bark.aelia.4: Take care of yourself. Well… of what's left.
bark.aelia.5: Don't let Brokk tell you about Gerald. Too late?
codex.enemy.mender: A street medic patching up the Consortium's wounded… with duct tape. A green ring announces each heal: take him out first.
codex.enemy.warder: He hands out shields like others hand out flyers. A light blue circle surrounds his protégés: hit them until it breaks, or go straight for him.
codex.enemy.leaper: An acrobat on springs. The red circle shows where he'll land: get out, then hit him while he recovers.
codex.enemy.diffuser: A projectile sprinkler: eight shots at once, in every direction. Slip between two aim lines.
boss.variantSub: A deadlier version… and a more generous one
challenge.dark.sub: The enemies see in the dark. You, a little.
challenge.champion.sub: A single opponent… but what an opponent
god.ra.quote.1: You again? Good. The sun loves stubborn people.
god.ra.quote.2: Burn them. I'll handle the lighting.
god.ra.quote.3: Even under the Oath, a sun is still a sun.
god.ra.quote.4: Don't stare at my boons too long, you'll hurt your eyes.
god.zeus.quote.1: One bolt, two bolts… I stopped counting, and so did you.
god.zeus.quote.2: Don't tell Hera I'm helping you. Or anyone, really.
god.zeus.quote.3: Lightning never strikes twice in the same place. I do.
god.zeus.quote.4: My Corporate Olympus shareholders don't know about this. Shh.
god.skadi.quote.1: The cold doesn't forgive. Neither do I.
god.skadi.quote.2: Freeze them, and take your time. They've run out of theirs.
god.skadi.quote.3: I've hunted in storms worse than this city.
god.skadi.quote.4: Advice: dress warmly. Oh, you're made of fire. Never mind.
god.anubis.quote.1: I weigh souls. Yours is… light. Surprising.
god.anubis.quote.2: The nearly dead? I handle the paperwork.
god.anubis.quote.3: You die often, little ash. I've opened a file in your name.
god.anubis.quote.4: Judgement is swift. Yours, and theirs.
god.bastet.quote.1: Faster. Cats never run. They arrive.
god.bastet.quote.2: Claw first, think later. It always works.
god.bastet.quote.3: I'm lending you nine lives. Return them in good condition.
god.bastet.quote.4: If you find a ball of yarn, it's mine.
god.athena.quote.1: A good strategy starts with not getting hit.
god.athena.quote.2: My aegis stopped titans. It can stop a few drones.
god.athena.quote.3: Think before you charge. No? Fine, charge, I've got you.
god.athena.quote.4: Has Zeus spoken to you yet? Don't believe a word he says.
god.artemis.quote.1: I never miss. You do, sometimes. We'll fix that.
god.artemis.quote.2: The moon sees everything, even in this nightless city.
god.artemis.quote.3: Keep your distance. My arrows will handle the rest.
god.artemis.quote.4: Hunting season is open. All year round, in this city.
god.thor.quote.1: BOOM! Sorry. That's how I say hello.
god.thor.quote.2: If it moves, hit it. If it stops moving, hit it anyway.
god.thor.quote.3: Brokk forged my hammer, you know. Has he told you about Gerald?
god.thor.quote.4: Stun them! It's easier to hit what doesn't move.
god.hel.quote.1: Half of me wants you alive. The other half doesn't care.
god.hel.quote.2: Curse them. I'll handle the afterlife, and the mess.
god.hel.quote.3: You always come back. I like loyal customers.
god.hel.quote.4: A last breath is all I give. Don't waste it.
story.thot_glitch.1: I… I… Sorry. I stutter when I recalculate your odds of survival. It happens a lot.
story.vesper_rumor.1: Ratatosk has been selling the same rune stone for three hundred years. Nobody has ever noticed. Don't tell him I told you.
story.vesper_arena.1: Seen the champion's arena? I'm the one selling tickets. You didn't pay, by the way.
story.thot_variants.1: Archive: the guardians learn from their defeats. Sometimes they'll come back stronger. So will you, I hope.
story.brokk_gerald.1: Gerald and I forged stars. Well… one star. Well… a spark. But a nice one.
story.vesper_sleep.1: The Master never sleeps. I do. Between two and three in the morning. Just saying. Not saying anything.
story.aelia_memory.1: This morning I forgot your name. Then I saw an ember dance, and I remembered.
story.aelia_memory.2: Don't worry. I always remember you. Always.
story.brokk_marks.1: The Fowler's beasts wear marks now? So do I: forge burns. Nothing tougher.
tutorial.move.touch: Put your thumb on the left of the screen and slide to move.
tutorial.move.keys: Move with WASD (or ZQSD) or the arrow keys.
tutorial.attack.touch: Tap the big orange button to attack. Chain hits for a combo!
tutorial.attack.keys: Attack with J or left click. Chain hits for a combo!
tutorial.attack.pad: Attack with □ / X. Chain hits for a combo!
tutorial.dash.touch: The blue ›› button: a quick dodge. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.
tutorial.dash.keys: Dodge with Space or Shift. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.
tutorial.dash.pad: Dodge with ✕ / A. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.
tutorial.power.touch: The → button: power attack, slower but stronger.
tutorial.power.keys: K or right click: power attack, slower but stronger.
tutorial.power.pad: △ / Y: power attack, slower but stronger.
